fn get_new_ews_ids_from_response(response: Vec<ItemResponseMessage>) -> Vec<String> {
    response
        .into_iter()
        .filter_map(|response_message| {
            response_message
                .items
                .inner
                .first()
                .and_then(|item| item.inner_message().item_id.as_ref().map(|x| x.id.clone()))
        })
        .collect()
